check: Identify the failing unit test and its assertion.
action: Locate the test file and the specific assertion that is failing. Do not modify the assertion itself.

check: Analyze the root cause of the failure.
action: Inspect the code under test (logic, data, dependencies) to determine why the assertion is not met. Check for off-by-one errors, incorrect state, or missing initialization.

check: Implement the fix in the source code.
action: Modify the implementation (not the test) to satisfy the existing assertion. Ensure the fix is minimal and does not introduce side effects.
Re-run the unit test to confirm it now passes. Ensure no other tests are broken by the change.
